rationale.faithful: Their own site already pairs a low-contrast grotesk with a geometric body at ordinary density — reproduce that dentist's-office cleanliness.
rationale.elevated: Patients researching a dentist want calm reassurance; quiet restraint and generous air read as trustworthy, not sterile.
rationale.reimagined: Inverting to ink turns a routine dental clinic into a confident modern practice, a real leap from their grey backdrop.

rationale.faithful: Mantiene el sans geométrico y la calma azul actuales, ordenando la jerarquía que hoy confunde al lector.
rationale.elevated: Una aventura submarina de Julio Verne pide calidez narrativa y un serif con carácter, no la frialdad de un producto digital.
rationale.reimagined: Para una experiencia familiar de aventura bajo el océano, un fondo tinta evoca la profundidad marina y da al relato un aire de expedición.

rationale.faithful: Keeps the sans-on-paper, compact-card format that already carries the red brand and people photography well.
rationale.elevated: The heavy reliance on people photography deserves generous air and a quieter type voice so faces, not chrome, carry the page.
rationale.reimagined: A confident red-driven brand can invert to ink and let the colour become a genuine statement instead of an accent.

rationale.faithful: Keeps the sans-geometric identity and tidy compact layout the firm already uses, just with a working hierarchy.
rationale.elevated: A legal practice earns trust through restraint, so quiet register with real air replaces the busy palette and flat scale.
rationale.reimagined: Inverting to ink gives the firm gravitas and authority, a bolder move than a law site usually risks but still legible and composed.

rationale.faithful: Sixteen mixed images and six sections suggest a personal, photo-led site best served by an editorial feed as-is.
rationale.elevated: With no brand colour asserting itself and heavy imagery, quiet restraint lets the photographs and Catalan voice carry the page.
rationale.reimagined: A dense, image-rich personal site could become a warm, unhurried read that trusts a serif and slows the pace.

rationale.faithful: Their own layout already leans on many small photos at a brisk pace; keep the geometric sans and tight rhythm.
rationale.elevated: A green service mark deserves quiet confidence and air so the 256 images can breathe instead of crowd.
rationale.reimagined: Inverting to ink turns a place-heavy, photo-dense identity into a gallery-like showcase with real visual authority.

rationale.faithful: Keeps their geometric sans and comfortable spacing, only fixing the contrast failure the measurements exposed.
rationale.elevated: A single disciplined hue replaces the five scattered clusters, letting the geometric sans finally read as chosen.
rationale.reimagined: An ink ground and a decisive grotesk give this unresolved brand the confidence its scattered palette never had.

rationale.faithful: A physio practice benefits from clean, approachable sans type and orderly compact cards like their current site.
rationale.elevated: Recovery and care call for calm generous space and a trustworthy humanist sans, not a dense clinic-brochure grid.
rationale.reimagined: Inverting to a dark, confident ground reframes physiotherapy as expert body-science, a real departure from the clinical-white norm.

rationale.faithful: Keeps the site's own quiet green restraint and airy sectioning, letting the sans headings breathe as they already do.
rationale.elevated: A botanical business earns a serif with warmth and craft, giving the greenery a print-heritage trust it currently lacks.
rationale.reimagined: Inverting to ink turns the herbal greens into a moody apothecary statement, a real departure from the current paper-and-pastel look.

rationale.faithful: Poppins geometric sans and single-hue red on white are already their whole identity — keep it plain.
rationale.elevated: The red is their one real asset; give it room to signal against generous quiet space instead of competing sections.
rationale.reimagined: Inverting to ink lets the brand red act like a signature stamp rather than a button colour, a real departure from their flat white site.
